summary: Kenon Holdings filed a Form 6-K announcing an agreement to acquire a 25% indirect equity interest in Vicinity District Energy for approximately $450 million in cash, alongside Harrison Street Asset Management, buying a majority stake from an Antin Infrastructure Partners-related seller. The deal implies a $2.92 billion enterprise value for 100% of Vicinity, subject to closing adjustments for cash, working capital and debt. Lenders committed up to $1.4 billion of non-recourse debt plus a growth capex facility. Vicinity operates district heating/cooling in 12 US cities with over $140 million run-rate EBITDA. Watch closing conditions, financing terms, and Kenon's cash deployment and concentration risk.
